narrative: The late-June agent-tooling CVE cluster is the incident pressure this thesis rests on: the Flowise custom-MCP command-injection ran arbitrary host commands precisely because a blocklist was defeated by a regex bypass, and AutoGen Studio executed agent-generated code in the host process from insufficient containerization. Blocklist-defeated-by-bypass is exactly the failure mode that argues frameworks toward allowlist, least-privilege, read-only-by-default execution guards, so today re-anchors the precondition after dormancy.
remaining_gap: No named framework has shipped a read-only-by-default SQL or execution guard; today is injection-class incident pressure, not a productized default control.
